subject: maths
question: 14 men can build a wall 55 m long in 5 days. How long can 21 men build that wall in 4 days?
solution:
Given:

14 men can build a wall 55 m long in 5 days.

Formula used:

(M₁ × T₁)/W₁ = (M₂ × T₂)/W₂

Where M₁ and M₂ is numbers of men

T₁ and T₂ is Time taken to complete the work

W₁ and W₂ is the work done

Calculation:

Applying the above formula

⇒ (14 × 5)/55 = (21 × 4)W₂

⇒ W₂ = 84 × 11/14

⇒ W₂ = 66 m

∴ The required length of the wall will be 66 metre
